doc: FBL 0.11, section 5.2 (gather), FR-013, written here: the tags of a declaration and the tags statements of its block read as one list, in document order, each argument an item; an argument holding a comma is one item, as the binding reads it. A gathered attribute is read-only, so a set of it is refused and nothing is written.

steps.doc: A set of a gathered, read-only attribute is refused.
